reports.title: Dutch Bros Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: •Total revenues are now projected to be at least $2.1 billion.
•Same shop sales growth is now estimated to be at least 5%.
•Adjusted EBITDA2 is now estimated to be approximately $380 million.
•Capital expenditures are now estimated to be between $370 million and $390 million.
